# kubesense_dashboard_list (Resource)

A dashboard list: a named group of dashboards, shown as a folder in the UI. A dashboard can be in several lists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kubesense_dashboard_list" "payments" {
  name        = "Payments"
  description = "Owned by the payments team"
  dashboard_ids = [
    kubesense_dashboard_json.checkout.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) List name. Unique across lists.

### Optional

- `dashboard_ids` (Set of String) Ids of the dashboards in the list. When set, Terraform owns membership: dashboards added in the UI are removed on the next apply. When omitted, membership is left to the UI.
- `description` (String) List description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) List id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import kubesense_dashboard_list.payments 9c41d7e2-3b0a-4c5f-8e21-5f6a7b8c9d01
```
